articles.title: Flyers Friday Flashback: Andre the Giant
Utah Faces Philadelphia in a Sunday Matinee

doubtful.detail: recalled from AHL; unclear if he will play (game-time decision)

away.summary: The Utah Mammoth (9-5-0) are second in the Central Division and 6-4-0 over their last 10 games. They are in the second match of a six-game road trip after a 4-3 overtime win against Pittsburgh on Thursday, led by Logan Cooley's hat trick and Mikhail Sergachev's overtime winner. Coach Andre Tourigny indicated there could be game-time decisions, and the team could use the same lineup from Pittsburgh.

home.summary: The Philadelphia Flyers (3-8-4) have lost three straight after a three-game winning streak, including a 4-3 overtime loss to Columbus and a 5-2 loss in Washington. Goaltending has alternated between Dan Vladar and Joseph Woll. Travis Konecny and Owen Tippett practiced fully for a second straight day and could be activated from injured reserve, though it was not confirmed as of the pre-game writing.
